note: Dominant geological process tags. Grade A = peer-reviewed source checked in this session; B = authoritative non-peer-reviewed record already in EGIZ references; C = non-academic secondary source checked in this session; D = derived from the window name or general knowledge, NOT verified. Grades C and D are hypotheses for the field-research planner to verify.

compatibility.rule: 1.0 if any process tag is shared; otherwise 0.2 (morphology may still be useful but formation process differs). Declared judgment, varied in sensitivity analysis.
